messages:
Evelyn (AE): Heads-up — Equinox Capital sent an RFP snippet asking for: dedicated EU-only deployment, HSM/BYOK, embeddings TTL=0, and a capped 30-day POC budget. Need capability matrix + short SQQ answers + POC estimate by Thu EOD. Can we triage?
Ravi (Solutions): I'll take matrix and POC scope. Suggest 2-phase POC: smoke (auth + sample prompts) then perf (throughput + 99p latency). Will mark acceptance criteria.
Nora (Security): For BYOK/HSM we support CloudHSM and PKCS#11. We'll state: keys remain in customer HSM; we support attestation and key rotation via KMS APIs. For embeddings TTL=0 we can enable no-persist mode but add note about transient caches. I'll draft SQQ snippets.
Derek (Eng): EU-only deploy is doable in eu-west-1. Ops lead time ~4 business days for infra + certs. For "no logs" option we can disable application-level traces but need contract clause allowing short-lived diagnostics during incidents.
Maya (Finance): Quick on pricing — for a 30-day POC with 2x A100 equiv dedicated: estimated not-to-exceed = $YY,YYY including setup. If they want hard cap, require prepayment. I'll put a line item breakdown.
Evelyn (AE): Please upload draft matrix and SQQ answers here. I'll consolidate and send by Thu. :calendar:
Ravi (Solutions): Pushed draft matrix to shared drive and added a tiny curl example for smoke: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFX" -X POST https://private.eu.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'`
Nora (Security): Uploaded redacted pen test summary and a FedRAMP-controls shortlist. Will finish SQQ by Wed noon.
Maya (Finance): Uploaded POC cost workbook with day rates and optional pentest pass-through.
Evelyn (AE): Thanks team — please review edits by Wed EOD so I can send to buyer Thu morning.
